segments.text:
V. 22.
Ye now therefore have ſorrow—This gives us no Manner of Authority to aſſert, all Believers muſt come into a State of Darkneſs. They never need loſe either their Peace or Love, or the Witneſs that they are the Children of GOD. They never can loſe theſe, but either thro' Sin or Ignorance, or vehement Temptation, or bodily Diſorder.
